Wonderful food carefully prepared
Jan 2025 • Couples
A great small Japanese restaurant providing excellent versions of many Japanese dishes as well as some regional or unusual variations. The kitchen uses high quality ingredients, carefully prepared to provide subtle and nuanced flavors. We ate there twice enjoying different dishes each time and thoroughly recommend it. Kind attentive service provided by the owner and his staff.

Favourite Japanese Lunch!
Nov 2020
This is my favourite place for lunch in District 3. The establishment is clean and has a really comfortable atmosphere. The food is fresh and the menu has a great range of items to choose from. I really enjoy the lunch combination which is a healthy choice but I hear the curry is a top pick so I'll be trying that next. The staff are also very lovely and tentative. Highly recommend this one.
